inputiaPermissionHelp.title: Inputia permissions
inputiaPermissionHelp.description: Only the Inputia main app needs Accessibility access. The input method handles basic typing without a separate grant.
inputiaPermissionHelp.settings: Pause input control and open permissions
inputiaPermissionHelp.note: Maintenance and recovery do not change system grants. If the main app is unavailable, voice and target-verified features pause while basic typing remains available.
inputiaPermissionHelp.missing: The input method for this installation was not found. Install the matching Inputia component first; the daily installation will not be used as a fallback.
inputiaPermissionHelp.failed: Could not open the location. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security manually, or try again.
inputiaPermissionHelp.rechecking: Checking permissions and rebuilding input control. Previous recordings and text are not replayed.
inputiaPermissionHelp.notStopped: Input control has not stopped safely. Permission settings were not opened. Restart the affected component before changing permissions.
inputiaPermissionHelp.pausedNote: Input control is paused. After finishing in System Settings, return here to recheck and restore.

confirmHistoryTerm.title: Confirm a term
confirmHistoryTerm.description: Enter one verified term (2–32 characters), not the full transcript. The source and revision must pass privacy checks.
confirmHistoryTerm.consent: I confirm this term and allow it to be saved to the local dictionary only.
confirmHistoryTerm.saved: Saved to the local dictionary. Shared use by speech recognition and the input method is still being integrated in this candidate.
confirmHistoryTerm.failed: The result is not confirmed. Retrying uses the same operation. Changed, untrusted or sensitive sources cannot be learned.
confirmHistoryTerm.replayed: This confirmation was already processed and will not learn again. Later deletion or forgetting remains in effect.

knowledge.title: Knowledge library
knowledge.description: Search documents, voice transcripts, captured typing snippets and clipboard records together.
knowledge.sourceHelp: Indexing and external AI access are separate permissions. Removing a linked source keeps your original files.
knowledge.removeConfirm: Unlink {{name}}? Original files will remain on disk.
knowledge.empty: No matching knowledge. Add a source or try another search.
knowledge.connectionHelp: Generate a prompt for an AI that can run local commands. It explains how to install the skill and query the sources you allow. Web-only AI cannot directly read this computer. Retrieved text may be sent to the AI provider.
knowledge.managedHelp: Changing the knowledge folder switches the indexed location; existing files are not moved.
knowledge.formats: Supports UTF-8 text files including Markdown, CSV, JSON and YAML, up to 5 MiB each. PDF and Word documents are not supported yet.
knowledge.moreResults: More results are available. Refine your keywords or select a source.
knowledge.partialImport: Some files could not be imported. See the details below.
knowledge.truncated: This preview contains the beginning of a long record. The external query tool can read subsequent pages.
knowledge.typingUnavailable: Verified typing records are not connected yet. Use New note to add content.
knowledge.captureTypingHelp: Captures only text confirmed as committed by Inputia in a verified non-sensitive field, not other input methods or global keystrokes. Turning this off keeps existing records. Search inclusion and external AI access are controlled separately.
knowledge.clearTypingConfirm: Clear all typing records from the knowledge library? These records cannot be restored. Text in the original apps stays unchanged, and future automatic capture remains unchanged.
knowledge.deleteTypingConfirm: Delete the typing record “{{title}}” from the knowledge library? This record cannot be restored. Text in the original app stays unchanged.

personalization.title: Typing habits and suggestions
personalization.description: Inputia learns locally to improve suggestions without a network model, independently of full-text capture and external AI access. Turning this off keeps learned data. This switch does not control Rime’s native user dictionary, which continues learning under its own rules.
personalization.backfillHelp: History is used only when you explicitly select a source and confirm. Existing history stays unchanged.
personalization.confirmBackfill: Use up to {{count}} records from “{{source}}” to learn input habits? Choosing this source authorizes this learning batch only; external AI access remains unchanged.
personalization.confirmForget: Forget Inputia’s personalization contributions for “{{text}}”? Original history and Rime’s native user dictionary stay unchanged.
personalization.confirmClear: Clear all learning contributions in Inputia’s personalization layer? This cannot be undone. Original history and Rime’s native user dictionary stay unchanged.

summaryFields.skipped: Skipped this batch: {{count}} (duplicates, no learnable phrases or capacity limits)

personalization.moreHistory: This source has more records. Continue the next batch explicitly.
personalization.partialTerms: Term and learning-event counts and the term list include only sources verified in this pass, not all imported records. The total import count is shown separately.

privacy.scope: Forgetting removes learned evidence and shared terms in both learning stores, then waits for active readers to revoke or expire. Original history, attachments, and words explicitly added in Settings are kept.
privacy.processing: Verifying domain receipts and active readers
privacy.partial_failure: Partially complete — recovery will retry automatically
privacy.completed: Learning evidence forgotten; active readers settled
privacy.repair: Completion evidence is missing or inconsistent. Personal learning stays paused until matching databases and keys are restored and verified. Original records are kept.

coverage.primary_only: This receipt covers unified terms, personalization and registered readers only. This runtime has not taken ownership of the legacy input method learning database.
coverage.all_domains: Completion covers unified terms, personalization, the legacy input method learning database and registered readers. Original history and explicit dictionary entries remain.
coverage.legacy_coverage_unresolved: This historical receipt only proves the earlier two learning domains were processed. Legacy learning coverage is unresolved; its derived features are paused pending verified handoff and repair. Basic input and history remain available.

inputSettings.title: Input method preferences
inputSettings.description: Change Inputia input preferences. Save changes explicitly; active input sessions confirm applied fields separately.
inputSettings.iconRestart: The menu icon requires an input method restart or reinstall. Saving does not confirm a live icon change.
inputSettings.spellingHint: Available for supported full pinyin schemes. Switching to double pinyin preserves this preference for later use.
inputSettings.learningHint: Turning learning off stops new learning. Use Personalization in Knowledge to forget previously learned data.
inputSettings.sensitiveHint: One application bundle ID per line. At least one entry is required; up to 512 entries, each no more than 256 bytes.
inputSettings.pending: The previous operation is retained. Retry the same request to find its result. Stopping retries does not undo a change that may already have been saved.
inputSettings.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Your attempted values are shown alongside the current saved values. Nothing is automatically merged or retried.
inputSettings.expired: This operation’s receipt is no longer available. Its outcome cannot be inferred. Review the current values before making a new change.
inputSettings.editCurrent: Discard this draft and edit current values
inputSettings.externalHint: Review the complete external file. Confirming imports exactly these observed bytes. A later file change requires a new preview.
inputSettings.extraValues: Other values in the file (read only)
inputSettings.extraValuesHint: These include runtime paths and extension fields. They will be included in the explicit file import, but this panel does not edit them.
inputSettings.replayed: Confirmed from the original operation receipt.
inputSettings.newerCurrent: The latest saved revision is now {{revision}}.
inputSettings.discardBroken: Discard unreadable local retry record and reload
inputSettings.historyHint: Voice and clipboard history are synchronized by the unified history service. Manage personal learning and forgetting in Knowledge → Personalization. Directory and license controls remain in their existing settings pages.
inputSettings.applicationHint: Only recently observed input sessions are listed. Confirmations expire within 2.5 seconds and cover the named fields; saving alone does not confirm application in every process.
inputSettings.noSessions: No recent input session confirmation is available.
inputSettings.sessionCount: {{matching}} of {{total}} observed sessions match the displayed saved version.

errors.invalid_document: The settings document is invalid. Repair the file before continuing.
errors.invalid_request: Check the input values and allowed ranges. No new valid request was sent.
errors.unsafe_path: The settings path could not be verified. No change was accepted.
errors.storage_unavailable: Settings storage is unavailable. Keep the retained operation and retry after storage recovers.
errors.busy: Another settings operation is active. Retry the retained operation later.
errors.maintenance: Inputia maintenance is active. Retry after maintenance finishes.
errors.external_edit: The settings file was edited externally. Preview it before explicitly importing it.
errors.external_changed: The external file changed after the preview. Stop the retained retry, preview again, and confirm the new file.
errors.repair_required: Settings recovery requires repair. Saved values and application cannot currently be confirmed.
errors.commit_uncertain: The save outcome is unknown. Retry the retained operation with the same identity.
errors.operation_mismatch: The operation identity does not match this request. Do not retry it with changed values.
errors.revision_exhausted: The settings revision limit has been reached. Storage repair is required.
errors.unsupported_platform: This input method settings service is available on macOS.
errors.response_unknown: The service result could not be verified. A retained operation must be retried unchanged to determine its outcome.
errors.pending_storage_unavailable: The local retry record could not be read or saved. Changes are blocked until local storage is available.
errors.pending_record_invalid: The local retry record is unreadable. Its original outcome is unknown. Discarding the record only allows a fresh read; it does not undo any earlier save.
errors.pending_operation_changed: Another page replaced the local retry record. Reopen this page to recover the currently retained operation; no other operation was cleared.

startupRecovery.title: Inputia kon niet volledig worden gestart
startupRecovery.editable: Je bestaande gegevens zijn behouden. Controleer het instellingenbestand en start Inputia opnieuw.
startupRecovery.pendingRecovery: Het herstel is nog niet voltooid. Je kunt Inputia opnieuw starten om het nogmaals te proberen. Wijzig de bestaande bestanden niet.
startupRecovery.unconfirmed: De opstartstatus kon niet worden bevestigd. Controleer opnieuw.
startupRecovery.actionFailed: De actie kon niet worden voltooid. Probeer het opnieuw.

modelStorage.busy: Another model operation is still running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it and retry.
modelStorage.downloadLimit: The model exceeds the configured download limit. Any existing partial download has been kept.
modelStorage.archiveSizeLimit: The unpacked model exceeds the configured size limit. The downloaded archive has been kept.
modelStorage.archiveEntryLimit: The model archive contains more entries than the configured limit. The archive has been kept.
modelStorage.archiveMetadataLimit: The model archive metadata exceeds the supported limit. The archive has been kept.
modelStorage.insufficientSpace: The disk is full or its quota has been reached. Downloaded files have been kept; free some space and retry.
